blocks.text: The wind whooshes. The leaves rustle. Footsteps go pitter-patter.

Artist Kim Joon, children from Seoul Metropolitan Children’s Hospital, and their families explored the museum and its surroundings. Together, they listened to the world around them, recorded what they heard, and turned those sounds into works of art.
The exhibition Crinkle, Crinkle, Whisper, Whisper grew out of their seven-week journey through sound and the senses.
Take a moment to listen closely.
The world has more stories to tell than you might think.
